exa_version: Exa 3.0 era. 3.0 added no new research/agent product; Agent (2026-06-16) and ultra + /stop (2026-09-24) predate it. Whether Agent's internal searches use the 3.0 retrieval stack is not stated.

freshness_overlay.query_suffix: Only use sources published on or after {{AFTER_DATE}}.

query_transform_notes: Exa Agent best practices: treat query as a task spec (entity, scope, evidence bar, fields to return). No outputSchema: 'If a prose answer is enough, omit it and read output.text'; citations come back in output.grounding.

async.on_timeout: POST https://api.exa.ai/agent/runs/{id}/stop (keeps results gathered so far)

cost_model: Fixed effort 'high' = $0.50/request (pricing page). Fixed efforts are not metered by ACU; budget.maxCostDollars only caps contact enrichment for fixed efforts.

async.timeout_s.note: Docs give no latency figures for effort levels ('high: slower, more thorough'). 30 min is our ceiling; record actual durations.

docs.supports: POST /agent/runs fields, effort enum, polling, output.text/grounding, prices per effort
query as task spec, effort guidance, no outputSchema for prose, persist run id
minimal $0.012, low $0.025, medium $0.10, high $0.50, xhigh $1.00, auto/ultra metered
/agent/runs 5 QPS, 50 active runs; POST counts as 2 requests; polling free

rationale.effort: 'high' is the most thorough fixed (predictable-price) effort below xhigh. Docs: use fixed effort for predictable per-request cost; xhigh/ultra when completeness matters more than cost. Variant EXA-R-XHIGH ($1.00) pre-registered.
rationale.outputSchema: Omitted; prose + output.grounding is the documented shape when downstream reads text.
